title: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x18 - Nature Pants - Opposite Day
sourceFilename: SpongeBob SquarePants - 1x18 - Nature Pants - Opposite Day.en.srt

cues.rawText:
* who lives in a pineapple
under the sea? *

* absorbent and yellow
and porous is he. *

* if nautical nonsense be
something you wish... *

* then drop on the deck
and flop like a fish. *
Mister Krabs, what do we do?

I've had to scrape you
off of something.

We need to get you
thinking about work.

No offense, Mister Krabs,
but i've been thinking

About giving up
my cold industrial life

In favor of
a more natural

And free life
among the jellyfish.

Even one day
in the wild.

And this... oh, this
is your golden scepter

That's better than nasty old
jellyfish, right, Spongebob?

Oh, i can too
last more than one day.

Oh, he'll be back,
all right.

I want you to have
my can opener.

And i thought
this friendship
would never pay off.

Are you sure you want
to give me this mayonnaise?

Patrick, there is
one more thing

Hey, Spongebob, you
having a garage sale?

No, Sandy, i'm giving up
my material possessions

To live in the wild
with the jellyfish.

Spongebob, of
all the crazy schemes

Why would you want to live
among the jellyfish?

They're cold and mean
and none too bright.

Oh, Sandy, that's exactly
the response i would expect

From someone who lives
the sham of a life
i once lived.

I'll prove i don't need
this stuff to be happy.

Maybe someday you'll
wise up and join me.

I'm home, i'm home, i'm home,
i'm home, i'm home, i'm home

Brothers and sisters,
wait for me.

My jellyfish instincts
tell me to go...

Hello, i'm jellybob--
And you are...?

Here, Patrick,
have a krabby patty.

I think i'm getting
the hang of this.

If i can't have you as a friend,
i'm going to make you a trophy.

I even picked out
this nice jar for you.

You're going
to look good
on my mantel.

So this is the way
it's going to be.

Ah, my jellyfish brethren
are returning.
Being a jellyfish sure is fun.
Itchy-- Why am i so itchy?

Ow, ow, itch, itch,
itch, itch, ow

Ooh, ow, ow, ow, itch, itch,
itch, itch, itch, itch...

I had a great life and friends,
and i gave all of that up.

Ah, quit your blubbering
and have a krabby patty.
And i'll see you at work

Spongebob, do us
all a favor...

It is great
to be home!

* pin the tail
on the sea horse! *

Don't do anything
i wouldn't do.

I'm moving out
of this neighborhood.

I can sell your home
in a heartbeat.

Because i want to move
as soon as possible.

No problem... as long as it's
not infested with nematodes
Oh, sure, there's none of that.
Of course! I can't tell you

How many times
i've seen a sale fall through

Anyway, i'll be by tomorrow
to check out the house.

No one will ever buy my house
with him living next door.

Whatever a good neighbor
would do, he does the opposite.

Why are you
playing the drum?

This is just
my wig case, see?

You don't know what
day it is, do you?
Boy, have you been missing out.

Opposite day is
the one day
of the year

When you get
to act different.

But today i'm silly
and spontaneous.

Does everybody know
about opposite day?

Normally, you're
really loud and annoying

So what are you
going to be today?
Quiet and out of the way.
Why don't you get a jump on it.

I mean, i hate
opposite day.

Gary, it's opposite day
and i'm--

I'm just going to crawl into bed
and do nothing all day.

Too bad it only comes
once a year, huh, Gary?
I never want to see you again!

Patrick, you're not
really not my friend.

Let me try,
let me try.

Let me show you how to do it...
the wrong way.

Do some work
around the house,
worst enemy?

Nearly noon
and not a peep from Spongebob.

You're the
worst neighbor
in history.

Wow! That's the nicest thing
Squidward has ever said to me.

If the real estate agent
sees that mess

I made my house
a mess

Which made Squidward
clean my yard

But that means
he's messing it up.

But the opposite
of clean is filth

Squidward's making
my yard a wreck

But i'd normally
wreck my own yard

So Squidward's
being the opposite
of Squidward

I must be the opposite
of Spongebob by being...
I want to be opposite, too.

It's not enough to look like
Squidward to be opposite.
You have to act like him, too.

Boy, oh, boy, do i like
playing the clarinet.

I practice and practice
all day long
But i never get any better.

Next time it's going to be
"go jump off a cliff" day.

The house is even more beautiful
in person.

I pictured you
being much taller.

Now, if you want
the sale to go through

All the positive
things about
your house.

The floor creaks,
the roof leaks.

Uh... well, you didn't
mention that on the phone.

There's a wild man-Eating clam
in the backyard.
Would you care to see the rest?

Well, i'm not sure
if i'm interested.

I won't take no
for an answer.

And here's the worst room
in the house: my gallery.

Oh, my, this painting
is very nice.

I'd like to introduce
you to mr. Squidward.

At least Spongebob
has been quiet.

Okay, i really
don't want to
hear another one.

I really don't
want to hear more,
thank you.

I hear you
loud and clear.
Oh, oh, i am so sorry, ma'am.
Haven't harmed you in any way.

What kind of fool
do you take me for?
I wouldn't sell a house for you

If you were
the last Squidward on earth!

Let me show you guys
how much i hate you.

That Squidward
likes us too much?
